title: CIC energiGUNE
content:
CIC energiGUNE is a research centre specialising in electrochemical and thermal energy storage, created in 2011 as a strategic initiative of the Basque Government. A private non-profit foundation in the Alava Technology Park, Spain, and member of the Basque Research & Technology Alliance (BRTA), it is considered a reference energy-storage laboratory in southern Europe.

Its portfolio covers lithium- and sodium-based batteries, supercapacitors, solid-state electrolytes, cell prototyping and post-mortem analysis, plus thermal storage research on phase-change materials, porous media and heat-transfer intensification, supported by characterization, testing and prototyping platforms.

For insulation and energy-storage suppliers, it provides testing, evaluation and co-development relevant to aerogel solutions in EV batteries, industrial heat and stationary storage.
excerpt: Basque energy-storage research centre (founded 2011) covering batteries, supercapacitors and thermal storage with testing and prototyping platforms.
